card.name: Just before a dose unit appears
card.fires_on: Opening parentheses, 'in', or 'Dose' right where a dose unit such as mg/kg, mg/m2 or mL is about to be written. It shows up in dosing tables and dose headings after a drug name.

modes.label: Parenthesis after drug or dose
modes.description: An opening bracket after a drug name or the word Dose, followed by the unit.

modes.label: 'in' after drug name
modes.description: The word 'in' after a drug name in a dosing sentence or table, before the amount or unit.
modes.example: Recommended doses of IOMERVU<< in>> pediatric patients for intra-arterial procedures

modes.label: Dose heading word
modes.description: The word Dose or a per-kilogram term in a dosing formula.
modes.example: CALVERT FORMULA FOR CARBOPLATIN DOSING Total D<<ose>> (mg) = (target AUC

card.writes: It promotes unit words such as kg, mm, cm and km, so it adds a measurement unit as the next word.
card.plain: It fires where a dose is about to be given with a unit like mg/kg.
